$comment: Hand-edited source of truth. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated from this by build.mjs; validate.mjs checks it. Structure transcribed from CLONE_SPEC.md (homepage), CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md (T1-T9 + route map) and CLONE_SPEC_PLATFORM.md (platform route map + section library); build status and implementedBy from src/App.jsx ROUTES and src/pages + src/components as of 2026-10-27, with every mounted route rendered against the local dev server. Content is the clone's invented brand (Corvale), so descriptions name structure and role only.

meta.title: Corvale (attio.com design clone): information architecture
meta.source: Design-faithful clone of attio.com's nav-bar scope (React + Vite + Tailwind, react-router). Brand, copy and artwork are invented placeholders.
meta.status: mid-build: 16 of 32 routes (14 of 21 templates) mounted and rendering
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill (hand-written ia.json, generated IA.md + matrix.csv)
meta.statusField: Each template carries status: built (route mounted in src/App.jsx ROUTES and rendering) | in-progress (components exist but route not mounted) | planned (spec only).
meta.routeSectionsField: Platform templates are section libraries shared by several routes with different subsets/orders; their `sections` array is the union in typical order, and `routeSections` gives each route's exact top-to-bottom order (ids may repeat there). Per-section route counts in IA.md/matrix.csv for platform-only sections are therefore template-level upper bounds; the scope prose names the exact routes.

categories.SHELL: Page chrome outside <main>: site header variants, help docs bar/sidebar, footer variants.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block: first thing under the header, carries the page's H1/display line.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, testimonials and quotes, customer stories, stats.
categories.FEATURES: Product or program explanation modules: split accordions, card grids, media showcases, step lists, tiers.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive editorial or company body content that is not a product pitch (detail-page body, careers story, docs body, scrollytelling chapters).
categories.LISTING: Collections of many like items: directories, article/entry lists, job listings, course and lesson lists.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to get the visitor to act: pricing tables, forms, CTA bands, newsletter sign-ups, FAQ.
categories.WAYFINDING: Navigation within the page body: breadcrumbs, cross-links to sibling pages, link grids, resource cards, year switchers.

shell.site-header.description: Sticky marketing header: dismissible black announcement banner over a nav row (logo, two dropdown triggers with mega-panels, three plain links, sign-in + primary buttons; hamburger below lg). Light at load, swaps to its dark theme while over dark sections.
shell.site-header.scope: Every full-chrome template: homepage, pricing, all marketing long-form pages, contact, apps, blog, changelog and the modern and legacy platform templates. Not on architecture, help, engineering blog or developers.

shell.site-header-dark.description: Same header component held in its dark theme from first paint (opaque near-black bar, dark stroke border), because the whole page wrapper is dark.
shell.site-header-dark.scope: The engineering blog and the developers platform page only.

shell.site-header-bannerless.description: Header with the announcement banner removed (nav row only), with the page hero pulled up underneath it; still toggles dark over dark scenes.

shell.docs-header.description: Marketing header plus, below 992px, an extra docs bar holding a breadcrumb/menu trigger for the help sidebar.

shell.docs-sidebar.description: Sticky left docs sidebar: compact command-K search trigger, then a masked scroll area with group headers and Radix accordion items whose carets rotate and whose nested links sit on a left guide line. Hidden below 992px.

shell.site-footer.description: Dark footer: 12-column link grid of grouped columns, then a bottom bar with legal links.
shell.site-footer.scope: Every route except the three help routes.

shell.site-footer-light.description: Light variant of the footer with the same geometry: white ground, grey headings and links, pale bottom-bar band.

hero.home-scroll-scene.description: Homepage hero: sticky gradient/pinstripe background and sticky headline + CTA stack over a sticky product-window scene that plays as the section scrolls.

hero.pricing-plans.description: Pricing hero with a monthly/annual billing toggle and a row of four plan cards.

hero.page-hero.description: Plain centered marketing hero: badge pill, display headline, lead, optional CTA row, over a top-masked dot pattern; static (no entrance).
hero.page-hero.scope: Customers only (other long-form pages use their own hero variants).

hero.startups-logo-hero.description: Centered marketing hero followed by a two-row strip of program logos.

hero.careers-hero.description: Left-aligned hero with primary CTA beside a ringed avatar stack, ending in a hoverable commit-style square grid with a caption that updates on hover.

hero.app-partners-hero.description: Static row of framed app tiles above a centered hero with staggered entrance.

hero.creator-video-hero.description: Centered hero with CTA and entrance, followed by a continuously auto-scrolling carousel of 16:9 video slides with avatar and name pill.

hero.expert-hero.description: Centered hero with two CTAs, an edge-masked avatar cloud, and two crossfading testimonials stacked in place.

hero.contact-split-form.description: Single split section: left column of badge, headline, lead and a serif testimonial pinned to the bottom; right tinted panel holding the lead form (name row, email, two selects, textarea, submit, small print). Stacks below lg.
hero.contact-split-form.scope: Contact sales only; this one section is the whole page body.

hero.apps-hero.description: Centered hero with browse + secondary CTAs, followed by a hatched band of white cells holding app icons.

hero.app-header.description: App detail header: large rounded app icon beside H1, subtitle and primary CTA, with a hatched decorative strip in the last column.
hero.app-header.scope: The app detail template (three app routes).

hero.blog-featured-post.description: Featured article block: overline row, large underlined title, author line, full-width 16:9 image, then a cell-grid row of three secondary article cards.

hero.engineering-ascii-hero.description: Dark engineering hero: monospace uppercase H1, a wide generated ASCII-art panel (hidden below lg), then three dark featured article cards.

hero.changelog-hero.description: Changelog hero: breadcrumb overline row, centered H1 and lead, inline email subscribe form.

hero.architecture-typewriter.description: Very tall scroll hero pulled up under the header: sticky full-viewport canvas field, centered serif headline typed progressively by scroll with a blinking caret, and a scroll-cue pill.

hero.help-landing.description: Help landing head in the docs main column: animated conic-border announcement pill, H1, lead, large search trigger and a row of popular-topic tag buttons.

hero.docs-page-head.description: Docs page head: small slash breadcrumb, H1 and lead in the docs main column.
hero.docs-page-head.scope: Help academy and the help reference guide.

hero.platform-centered.description: Viewport-height centered platform hero: eyebrow pill, display headline, subhead, two CTAs, over route-specific original artwork (line grid with chips, agent canvas, or kanban board).
hero.platform-centered.scope: Modern platform template: web-agent, custom-agents and enrichment.

hero.platform-horizon.description: Platform hero with centered copy above a wide 3:1 horizon box of concentric arcs and glow, over a top-masked stripe field.

hero.platform-radar.description: Platform hero with copy centered inside a radar of concentric rings, a rotating beam and pinging dots.

hero.platform-mcp-grid.description: Platform hero laid on a square-cell grid with client-logo cells and a prompt box under the copy.

hero.platform-ask-canvas.description: Viewport-height hero over an animated canvas field with a chat widget mock under the copy, closed by a hairline-separated strip.

hero.platform-split-legacy.description: Left-aligned legacy platform hero with copy in the left columns and a product mock (table or flow diagram) beside or above it.
hero.platform-split-legacy.scope: Legacy platform template: call-intelligence and workflows.

hero.platform-data-perspective.description: Full-bleed tall hero: copy above a perspective-tilted wireframe of schema diagrams and a product window, with a sticky tab bar.

hero.platform-sequence-mock.description: Hero with a stacked email-step sequence mock between dashed rules above the copy.

hero.developer-blueprint.description: Dark blueprint hero on a 24-column line grid: bracketed overline, display headline, docs + outline buttons, artwork on the right.

proof.logo-cell-grid.description: Customer logo grid drawn as bordered cells (five columns by two rows with 1px gridlines; two columns on mobile), some cells linking with a corner arrow; logos fade in.
proof.logo-cell-grid.scope: Homepage plus the platform pages that carry it: custom-agents, mcp, reporting, universal-context, web-agent (modern) and workflows (legacy).

proof.logo-wall.description: Borderless wall of twelve monochrome logos in a six-column grid (fewer columns on smaller screens).

proof.program-partners.description: Centered section head, an inset logo wall of program partners, and a centered note.

proof.quote-curtain.description: White sticky quote panel on a dot grid that is revealed as the dark section above scrolls away like a curtain; serif quote with scroll-driven word reveal, text-only attribution.

proof.quote-reveal.description: Portrait-plus-quote row: cut-out portrait art on the left, serif quote with hanging open-quote whose words slide up once in view, attribution; partner pages add an overline and a favorite-features chip row.
proof.quote-reveal.scope: Customers, app partners and creator partners.

proof.quote-scroll-lit.description: Large centered serif testimonial on a dot field whose words change from grey to ink as the block scrolls through; attribution below; dashed guide rows above and below in the legacy shell.
proof.quote-scroll-lit.scope: Platform pages: enrichment (modern) and ask, call-intelligence, sequences, workflows (legacy).

proof.scale-stats.description: Stats section over an exponential-curve chart background: eyebrow, two-tone heading, two-by-two grid of numbers with blue left rules.

proof.customer-stories-tabs.description: Section head, a four-tab logo strip with timed progress fill, and one large story card (text left, saturating image right) that rotates with the tabs.

proof.customer-stories-grid.description: Grid of seven story cards over a dot pattern, alternating full-width feature cards (text + framed media) with two-up half cards.

proof.stat-headline.description: Split block: two-tone heading on the left, one very large container-scaled number with label on the right.
proof.stat-headline.scope: Modern platform template: custom-agents and mcp.

proof.developer-testimonial.description: Dark blueprint testimonial: mono name label, halftone portrait canvas, quote box whose words brighten.
proof.developer-testimonial.scope: Developers only (appears twice on the page).

features.platform-showcase.description: Long homepage product showcase: intro block then a tall bordered grid of feature panels with product mocks.

features.self-building.description: Centered eyebrow, heading and button over a tick-pattern band, ending in a record-detail product card cut off by the section bottom.

features.context-dark-stack.description: First dark section of the homepage context group: striped title region with mega headline, animated horizon/planet, feature row, auto-cycling tabs and a connectivity row.

features.sdk-block.description: Dark graph-paper panel with a two-tone heading and button on the left and a line illustration on the right.

features.startup-feature-cells.description: Section head, then a two-by-two cell grid of indexed media cards split by a full-width static centered quote cell, hatched gutters.

features.perks-orbit-band.description: Tinted band with a centered two-part statement over an orbit illustration of floating circular app tokens.

features.two-paths.description: Two-up cell grid of path cards (title, body, outline button) on a hatched ground.

features.build-steps-tabbed.description: Section head, a segmented two-tab switch, and a numbered step list (connector lines, per-character titles, descriptions) per tab, with a footer link row.

features.directory-path-steps.description: Section head plus the numbered step list without tabs (four steps) and a footer link row.

features.explore-apps.description: Section head and a bordered frame: text cell with a discover link on the left, original app-store mock illustration on the right.

features.creator-audience-cells.description: Centered section head and a three-up cell grid of labelled audience cards.

features.creator-perks.description: Centered head with outline CTA, then a cell grid of perks: a row of three illustrated cards over a row of three text-only cards.

features.expert-criteria-columns.description: Section head and a five-column row of left-bordered criteria with edge fades.

features.expert-tiers.description: Section head, three tilting tier cards (light, grey, dark) with ring emblems, patterned art and bullet lists, and a bordered footer strip with CTA.

features.featured-apps-tabs.description: Section head, five chip tabs (click only), and a panel with app icon/title/description on the left and a media box on the right that blurs in on change.

features.split-accordion.description: Modern split accordion: two-tone heading and three progress-tracked items on the left, cross-fading media panel on the right; full-bleed and stacked below lg.
features.split-accordion.scope: Modern platform template: web-agent, custom-agents, universal-context, enrichment and reporting (not mcp).

features.split-accordion-legacy.description: Legacy split accordion: heading with expandable items pinned to the bottom-left, dotted media well on the right, seam ticks between.
features.split-accordion-legacy.scope: Legacy platform template: call-intelligence, data, sequences and workflows (not ask).

features.split-icons.description: Two-column block: heading on the left, three stacked icon + text articles on the right.

features.media-grid-three.description: Modern three-up media cards under a two-tone heading, artwork above title and body (one or two rows).
features.media-grid-three.scope: Modern platform template: web-agent, universal-context, mcp, enrichment and reporting (not custom-agents).

features.legacy-card-grid-three.description: Legacy three-up cards in a dashed, hatched frame with square dotted media wells; a text + icon variant drops the media.
features.legacy-card-grid-three.scope: Legacy platform template: call-intelligence, data, sequences and workflows (data and workflows also use the text + icon variant).

features.legacy-card-grid-quad.description: Legacy two-by-two indexed media cards in a hatched frame, optionally split by a full-width inline serif quote row.
features.legacy-card-grid-quad.scope: Legacy platform template: call-intelligence, data and sequences (sequences without the quote).

features.center-media.description: Centered two-tone heading above one large product image on a fading stripe field.
features.center-media.scope: Modern platform template: custom-agents, universal-context, mcp and enrichment.

features.card-marquee.description: Two rows of small task cards moving in opposite directions with scroll, over a line or stripe field; centered heading (modern or legacy stacked style).
features.card-marquee.scope: Platform pages: custom-agents (modern) and workflows, ask (legacy).

features.text-columns.description: Heading then a horizontally snapping row of left-bordered text columns with ruler feet; numbered-steps variant adds a docs button.
features.text-columns.scope: Modern platform template: universal-context, enrichment and mcp (steps variant).

features.orbit-illustration.description: Centered illustration on a horizon hairline, centered heading, three text columns.

features.icon-row.description: Heading then a three-up row of tall icon + text cells.

features.tagged-quad.description: Heading on the left, two-by-two grid of bracket-tagged cards on the right.
features.tagged-quad.scope: Modern platform template: web-agent and universal-context.

features.bento-grid.description: Legacy-style centered header over an eight-column bento of four media cards in alternating wide/narrow rows.

features.integration-arc-strip.description: Short tinted strip with a centered two-part line and app tiles placed along a large arc, masked at the bottom.

features.product-showcase-legacy.description: Legacy header then a full-width product screenshot in a tinted, horizontally scrollable box.

features.tabbed-showcase.description: Legacy tabbed showcase: block heading, outline pill tabs (click only), panel with title, body and media.
features.tabbed-showcase.scope: Legacy platform template: call-intelligence and data.

features.ask-tab-carousel.description: Centered heading, five text tabs over a draggable tick ruler, and the selected panel.

features.uc-band.description: Viewport-height dark band: terrain canvas, small kicker above a large white headline, dashed guides, and a five-up row of dark corner-marked cells.
features.uc-band.scope: Legacy platform template: ask and workflows.

features.ask-intelligence.description: Centered header, a bottom-masked product window mock, then a three-up cell row of icon + text + floating mini-UI media.

features.agent-columns.description: Legacy five-column snapping row of bordered text columns with a dark title marker, ruler below and edge fades.

features.developer-card-section.description: Dark blueprint section: header with docs button, then grid-placed illustrated cards, sometimes with an inline quote strip between rows.
features.developer-card-section.scope: Developers only (three instances on the page).

content.interview-video.description: Large rounded video player with poster and custom control bar.

content.team-intro.description: Centered head, avatar dot-matrix shape, and a short testimonial.

content.team-photos.description: Short head then a grid of six team photos and an investor logo caption row.

content.values-grid.description: Section head and a two-by-two cell grid pairing pixel-art tiles with value statements.

content.app-detail-body.description: Two-column app body: sticky tinted meta aside (official pill, meta groups, outline CTA) and a main column with image gallery (thumbnails + lightbox) and three overview sections of prose and bullet lists.
content.app-detail-body.scope: The app detail template (three app routes).

content.engineering-heatmap.description: Dark contribution-style heat grid of small squares in five shades with a stats line, followed by a heading and a ghost link.

content.developer-heatmap.description: Dark blueprint header with outline button over a lined box holding a contribution-style grid and a mono caption.

content.architecture-chapter-band.description: Chapter divider band: tinted base with drifting radial-gradient blobs and a noise overlay, centered mono label and per-word serif title.
content.architecture-chapter-band.scope: Architecture only (three instances introduce the page's three chapters).

content.architecture-story-body.description: Two-column editorial body: mono/sans paragraphs with square bullets beside serif pull text, plus captioned chip diagrams.

content.five-reasons-index.description: Interactive index of five rows with oversized serif words, mono indices and hairlines that shift under the pointer.

content.problem-dark-scene.description: Dark full-height scene whose words brighten from faint to white as it scrolls.

content.architecture-diagram-scene.description: Ring-diagram row, then a tall sticky dark canvas stage with mono tags and pulsing dots, then numbered serif pillars with brightening words.

content.launch-feature-blocks.description: Four two-column feature blocks (serif heading, mono overline, paragraphs, SVG diagram), a tinted beta block and a dark code-art band.

content.help-get-started.description: Split block: multi-tone heading and short paragraphs on the left, numbered list of three steps with badge numbers on the right, see-all link.

listing.changelog-preview.description: Section head and four changelog cards (date, title, excerpt, tick strip with staggered hover recolor); horizontal snap row below lg.

listing.open-positions.description: Centered head, filter row (two selects + search), and department-grouped job rows with live filtering and an empty state.

listing.app-directory.description: Centered head with command-K search trigger, sticky category sidebar (chip row on tablet), and every app card rendered in category blocks with anchor scrolling (no pagination).

listing.related-apps.description: Bordered aside with overline and a three-column grid of six app cards.
listing.related-apps.scope: The app detail template (three app routes).

listing.article-list.description: Latest-articles block: heading, vertical category filter column (horizontal row on small screens) driving a query param, and a list of article rows with blur transition on filter; light or dark tone.

listing.changelog-entries.description: All entries for the selected year as hairline-separated rows: date, single-line title, two-line excerpt, tag lines, arrow; no pagination.

listing.course-grid.description: Two-column grid of course cards: rounded media, underlined title, description, lesson/duration meta.

listing.lesson-list.description: Vertical list of numbered lesson rows: badge number, title/description/read-more, rounded media on the right.

conversion.plan-comparison-table.description: Long feature comparison table across plans: sticky plan header with billing toggle, grouped rows with tooltips and expandable sub-rows.

conversion.faq-accordion.description: Centered FAQ: heading then an accordion of question rows with a bracketed plus-to-minus icon and height-animated answers.
conversion.faq-accordion.scope: Pricing, startups, and the three partner pages.

conversion.avatar-wall-cta.description: Closing CTA: dashed guide row, a wide wall of avatar tiles fading in at random delays, two-line heading that slides up, two buttons.

conversion.startup-apply-form.description: Split apply block: heading, bullets and note on the left; tinted panel with the lead form (text inputs and selects) on the right.

conversion.newsletter-band.description: Tinted band: section head and inline subscribe form on the left, tile illustration panel on the right.

conversion.newsletter-inline.description: Single-row newsletter sign-up: two-line two-tone line on the left, email input + subscribe button (spinner while submitting) on the right.
conversion.newsletter-inline.scope: Homepage (under the changelog cards) and the mcp platform page.

conversion.apply-closed-notice.description: Tinted anchor block with a dashed guide row and a single centered notice that applications are closed (no form).

conversion.expert-apply-embed.description: Tinted anchor block: section head on the left, embedded application form box on the right (own form or placeholder instead of the third-party embed).

conversion.build-with-us.description: Tinted closing band: section head + primary CTA on the left, decorative grid of white squares on the right.

conversion.home-final-cta.description: Homepage dark closing CTA: unmasked stripe field with falling light streaks, centered medium-weight headline, two dark buttons; email form on mobile.

conversion.platform-final-cta.description: Platform dark closing CTA: shorter than the homepage CTA, stripe field masked to a dome at top center, bold one- or two-line headline, tighter gap and padding, same streaks.
conversion.platform-final-cta.scope: Every modern and legacy platform page (not developers).

conversion.developer-cta.description: Dark blueprint closing block: centered heading with a mono command chip, surrounded by floating dark mock windows.

conversion.architecture-closing-nav.description: Sticky canvas closing stage with a serif line and a two-card mono nav linking to the sales contact page, with corner marks.

wayfinding.partner-cross-links.description: Centered head and a two-up cell grid linking to the other partner programs (the current one excluded), over a dot pattern.

wayfinding.resource-cards.description: Short heading block plus a row of three or four bordered resource cards (icon, arrow, title, description) with hover wash.
wayfinding.resource-cards.scope: Careers (four cards), expert partners (three) and help landing (three, larger icons).

wayfinding.app-breadcrumb.description: Tall breadcrumb bar ending at the bottom: directory / app overline on the left, counter overline on the right, dashed guide.
wayfinding.app-breadcrumb.scope: The app detail template (three app routes).

wayfinding.year-timeline.description: Row of year links centered over a perspective ruler of compressed vertical lines; current year highlighted.

wayfinding.platform-link-grid.description: Grid of eight numbered link cells to other platform pages with hover wash and arrow; legacy stacked-header frame or modern split layout.
wayfinding.platform-link-grid.scope: Platform pages: enrichment (modern) and call-intelligence, data, sequences (legacy).

wayfinding.developer-apps.description: Dark header with browse button, a row of app icons with labels, and a repository link row.

templates.name: App detail
templates.routeNote: Mounted as the single param route /apps/:slug. The live directory links far more app detail pages (one per directory card), but the nav-bar scope documented here is these three; other slugs resolve through the same template and are not counted.

templates.name: Architecture (scrollytelling)
templates.sectionNote: content.architecture-chapter-band appears three times (before the story body, the diagram scene and the launch blocks); listed once at its first position.

templates.name: Platform v2 (modern shell)
templates.sectionNote: Union of the section library this template draws from, in typical order. Each route uses a subset; see routeSections for exact order.

templates.name: Platform v1 (legacy shell)
templates.sectionNote: Union of the section library this template draws from, in typical order. Each route uses a subset; see routeSections for exact order (ids repeat where a route uses a section type twice).
